scope: Visible appearance candidates, not diagnosis, severity or dermatologist validation

rights.uncertainExistingSources: separate private engineering regression; no redistribution or product admission claim
rights.newSources: consent and rights record required before processing; no unclear download

capture.repeatPhysicalCapture: separate light/pose/distance/device study; not yet measured
capture.currentProduct: one snapshot per pose; no multi-frame persistence claimed

storage.snapshot: volatile until separately consented local photo export

engineeringStart: 10-20 explicitly permitted shots can start an engineering review, not sufficient sample size/general accuracy; not a prerequisite for offline coding
decision: Recall gain without reviewed-negative FP increase, or maintained recall with FP decrease; frozen A/B, no post-result threshold sweep
firstScan: independent candidate result if method admitted and quality valid; no personal baseline required
history: method/normalization/capture scope form comparison key; zero baseline percent undefined, never infinity
